---
title: "Deconvolution run report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    self_contained: true
    theme: flatly
    # keep "--option" text as typed rather than turning "--" into a dash
    md_extensions: -smart
params:
  proportions: null
  run_info: null
  figures_dir: null
  figure_format: "png"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 96
)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

run <- load_run_report_data(params$proportions, params$run_info)
props <- run$proportions
info <- run$info

fits <- report_fits(props)
malignant <- info$method$options$malignant_cell_type
labels <- info$reference$labels
ct <- props[props$level == "cell_type", ]
colours <- cell_type_colours(ct$label, malignant)
ordered_samples <- sample_order(props, fits$initial, malignant)
n_samples <- length(info$bulk$samples)
# above ~60 bulk samples, per-sample labels are unreadable
show_labels <- n_samples <= 60
has_update <- !is.na(fits$updated)

figure <- function(plot, name, width = 10, height = 4.5) {
  show_figure(
    plot,
    name,
    params$figures_dir,
    params$figure_format,
    width,
    height
  )
}
kable <- function(x, ...) {
  knitr::kable(
    x,
    format = "html",
    table.attr = 'class="table table-sm"',
    row.names = FALSE,
    ...
  )
}
html_escape <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(x)

funnel <- info$genes$funnel
genes_used <- funnel$used_by_method %||% funnel$after_exclusion
warnings_tbl <- if (length(info$warnings) > 0) {
  as.data.frame(info$warnings)
} else {
  data.frame(source = character(0), message = character(0))
}
method_label <- if (has_update) {
  paste0(info$method$name, " + update (", info$method$options$update_mode, ")")
} else {
  info$method$name
}
```

<style>
.keyfacts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin: 12px 0 20px; }

<div class="keyfacts">
<div><b>`r n_samples`</b><span>bulk samples</span></div>
<div><b>`r html_escape(info$reference$name)`</b><span>reference</span></div>
<div><b>`r length(unique(labels$cell_state))` / `r length(unique(labels$cell_type))`</b><span>cell states / cell types</span></div>
<div><b>`r fmt_n(genes_used)`</b><span>genes used (of `r fmt_n(funnel$bulk)` in bulk)</span></div>
<div><b>`r html_escape(method_label)`</b><span>method</span></div>
<div><b>`r nrow(warnings_tbl)`</b><span>warnings</span></div>
</div>

## Warnings

```{r}
#| label: warnings
#| results: asis
if (nrow(warnings_tbl) == 0) {
  cat('<div class="notebox">No warnings.</div>\n')
}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(warnings_tbl))) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="warnbox"><b>WARNING</b> (%s): %s</div>\n',
    html_escape(warnings_tbl$source[i]),
    html_escape(warnings_tbl$message[i])
  ))
}
```

### Batch-dependent settings

```{r}
#| label: batch-dependent
#| results: asis
batch <- info$batch_dependent_settings
if (length(batch) == 0) {
  cat(
    "<p>None: each bulk sample's estimates do not depend on the other",
    "bulk samples in this run.</p>\n"
  )
} else {
  for (setting in names(batch)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<div class="batch"><code>%s</code>: %s</div>\n',
      setting,
      html_escape(batch[[setting]])
    ))
  }
  cat(sprintf(
    paste(
      "<p>Running a subset of these %d bulk samples, or adding samples,",
      "will change the estimates. The full sample list is under",
      "<a href='#run-details'>Run details</a>.</p>\n"
    ),
    n_samples
  ))
}
```

## Proportions {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r}
#| label: proportions
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 4.5
order_note <- if (!is.null(malignant) && malignant %in% ct$label) {
  paste0("samples ordered by ", malignant, " proportion in ", fits$initial)
} else {
  paste0("samples ordered by the largest cell type in ", fits$initial)
}
for (fit in unique(ct$method)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", fit))
  figure(
    plot_stacked_proportions(
      ct[ct$method == fit, ],
      colours,
      ordered_samples,
      title = sprintf("Cell-type proportions: %s", fit),
      subtitle = paste0("Bulk ", order_note),
      show_labels = show_labels
    ),
    paste0("proportions_", fit)
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-states
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 3.5
# cell states only from the initial fit, for cell types with several states
cs <- props[props$method == fits$initial & props$level == "cell_state", ]
states_per_type <- table(labels$cell_type)
multi_state_types <- names(states_per_type[states_per_type > 1])
if (nrow(cs) > 0 && length(multi_state_types) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Cell states within cell types\n\n")
  type_of <- stats::setNames(labels$cell_type, labels$cell_state)
  for (type in multi_state_types) {
    # one plot per cell type, so each has its own legend
    figure(
      plot_cell_states(
        cs[type_of[cs$label] == type, ],
        type,
        ordered_samples,
        show_labels = show_labels
      ),
      paste0("cell_states_", make.names(type)),
      height = 3.5
    )
  }
}
```

### Heatmap

```{r}
#| label: heatmap
#| fig-height: 4
figure(
  plot_proportion_heatmap(ct, colours, ordered_samples, show_labels = show_labels),
  "heatmap",
  height = 1.5 + 2.5 * length(unique(ct$method))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-comparison
#| results: asis
#| fig-height: 5
if (has_update) {
  cat("\n\n## Fit comparison {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s against %s\n\n", fits$updated, fits$initial))
  figure(
    plot_fit_comparison(ct, fits$initial, fits$updated, colours),
    "fit_comparison",
    width = 7,
    height = 5
  )

  cat("\n\n### Distributions by cell type\n\n")
  figure(plot_fit_distributions(ct, colours), "fit_distributions")

  cat("\n\n### Mean proportions\n\n")
  means <- aggregate(proportion ~ label + method, data = ct, FUN = mean)
  means$proportion <- sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * means$proportion)
  wide <- stats::reshape(
    means,
    idvar = "label",
    timevar = "method",
    direction = "wide"
  )
  names(wide) <- sub("^proportion\\.", "", names(wide))
  names(wide)[1] <- "Cell type"
  print(kable(wide[order(wide[[1]]), ]))
}
```

## Inputs {.tabset .tabset-pills}

### Genes

```{r}
#| label: gene-funnel
#| fig-height: 2.8
figure(plot_gene_funnel(funnel), "gene_funnel", height = 2.8)
```

Bulk gene IDs were detected as **`r info$bulk$gene_id_type`**`r if (info$bulk$gene_id_type == "ensembl") " (version suffixes stripped)" else ""`; `r fmt_n(funnel$bulk_rows_read)` rows were read from the bulk file.

```{r}
#| label: excluded-genes
#| results: asis
n_markers <- info$genes$n_markers
if (!is.null(n_markers)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p>%s used %s marker genes (up to %d per cell type).</p>\n",
    info$method$name,
    fmt_n(n_markers),
    info$parameters$n_markers
  ))
}
excluded <- info$genes$excluded_genes
categories <- info$genes$excluded_categories
if (length(categories) == 0) {
  cat("<p>No gene categories were excluded.</p>\n")
} else {
  counts <- vapply(categories, function(x) length(excluded[[x]]), integer(1))
  print(kable(
    data.frame(category = categories, genes = counts),
    col.names = c("Excluded category", "Genes removed")
  ))
}
filtered <- info$method$info$genes_removed_by_filter
if (!is.null(filtered)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "<details><summary>%d genes removed by InstaPrism's outlier filter</summary>\n%s\n</details>\n",
    length(filtered),
    html_escape(paste(filtered, collapse = ", "))
  ))
}
```

### Reference

```{r}
#| label: reference-summary
#| results: asis
build <- info$reference$build
cat(sprintf(
  "<p>Reference <b>%s</b>%s. Cell states were %s in this run.</p>\n",
  html_escape(info$reference$name),
  if (length(build$input_files) > 0) {
    sprintf(", built from %d file(s)", length(build$input_files))
  } else {
    ""
  },
  if (isTRUE(info$reference$cell_states_used)) "used" else "not used"
))
```

```{r}
#| label: reference-table
#| results: asis
kept <- data.frame(
  `Cell type` = labels$cell_type,
  `Cell state` = labels$cell_state,
  Cells = labels$n_cells,
  `Reference samples` = labels$n_samples,
  Status = "",
  check.names = FALSE
)
dropped <- info$reference$dropped_labels
if (length(dropped) > 0 && nrow(as.data.frame(dropped)) > 0) {
  dropped <- as.data.frame(dropped)
  kept <- rbind(
    kept,
    data.frame(
      `Cell type` = dropped$cell_type,
      `Cell state` = ifelse(dropped$level == "cell_state", dropped$label, ""),
      Cells = dropped$n_cells,
      `Reference samples` = "",
      Status = sprintf(
        "dropped (fewer than %d cells)",
        info$parameters$min_cells
      ),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  )
}
kept <- kept[order(kept$`Cell type`, kept$`Cell state`), ]
kept$Cells <- fmt_n(kept$Cells)
print(kable(kept))
```

### Session info

```{r}
#| label: session-info
#| results: asis
si <- info$session_info
platform <- unlist(si$platform)
print(kable(
  data.frame(Setting = names(platform), Value = platform),
  escape = TRUE
))
packages <- as.data.frame(si$packages)
packages$attached <- ifelse(packages$attached, "*", "")
cat(sprintf(
  "<details><summary>%d loaded packages (* = attached)</summary>\n",
  nrow(packages)
))
print(kable(
  packages[, c("package", "attached", "version", "date", "source", "library")],
  col.names = c("Package", "", "Version", "Date", "Source", "Library"),
  escape = TRUE
))
cat("</details>\n")
```
